name: FW Dump
description: Copies your watch's 4 MB of internal flash, its firmware, into the app's folder as 32 files with a checksum for each, to copy off over USB. It also records what the image cannot say about itself: which chip, which firmware, and a snapshot of hardware registers. It only reads. The dump runs with USB unplugged and picks up where it left off if interrupted. On a firmware that isolates apps it refuses rather than crashing. A README in the folder explains the files and how to check the copy. One of them contains your watch's unique ID.

configFields.label: Start address
configFields.description: Where to start reading, in hex without 0x. Leave it for the whole of flash. Anything outside internal flash (08000000 to 083FFFFF) is refused and the whole of flash is dumped instead.
configFields.validationMessage: Hex digits only, up to 8, with no 0x.

configFields.label: Bytes to read
configFields.description: How much to read from the start address, in hex. Must be a whole number of chunks.
configFields.validationMessage: Hex digits only, up to 8, with no 0x.

configFields.label: Chunk size
configFields.description: Bytes per output file, in hex. The default makes 32 files of 128 KB.
configFields.validationMessage: Hex digits only, up to 8, with no 0x.

configFields.label: Write size
configFields.description: Bytes read and written at a time, in hex. Must divide the chunk size and be at most 4000 (16 KB).
configFields.validationMessage: Hex digits only, up to 8, with no 0x.
